x-kubernetes-validations.message: each url must be a valid http:// or https:// endpoint
a topic override must set at least one of key or value
each rules.routing condition needs at least one of topics / topicPatterns
security.cluster[].extensionHeaders may only be set on a passthrough entry when security.client.authentication.type is 'oauth'
security.client.authentication.oauthSettings.jwksEndpointUri is required when a security.cluster entry has auth 'swap' and security.client.authentication.type is 'oauth'
security.cluster[].secretStore may only be set when that entry's auth is 'swap'
security.cluster[].extensionHeaders cannot be set on an entry with authentication.type 'none' (no SASL handshake to inject into)
exactly one of streamingDomain (with a non-empty name) or a non-empty streamingDomains must be set
every streamingDomains entry must have a non-empty name
mode must be STATIC or DYNAMIC (case-insensitive)
fence and rules.fencing are mutually exclusive; remove one
rules.routing is only supported on a dynamic route (one bound via streamingDomains)
host-based routing (SNI) requires TLS; set security.client.tls
